title: Identic
summary: IDEN'TIC IDEN'TICAL, adjective [Latin idem, the same.] The same; not different; as the identical person; the identical proposition. We found on the thief the identical goods that were lost.

inlines.v: IDEN'TIC IDEN'TICAL, adjective [Latin idem, the same.] The same; not different; as the identical person; the identical proposition. We found on the thief the identical goods that were lost.
